test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Aakash starts from Point O and drives 3 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 5 km, turns right and drives 10 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 5 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point Z. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point O from Point Z? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution: According to the given information: Aakash starts from Point O and drives 3 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 5 km, turns right and drives 10 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 5 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point Z.
